Commentary.Commentary: Ireland put their head down and were phenomenal with the ball. Josh Little exploited the conditions really well early on and put Zimbabwe on the back foot straightaway by removing both the openers. The bowlers used the conditions very well and made life difficult for the Zimbabwe batters. Ervine and Madhevere did take the game away from them for a while but the spinners did exceedingly well in the middle overs to put Zimbabwe back on the back foot. Andy McBrine was outstanding as well and he picked up 3 wickets, just like Little. In the end, they bowled well as a bowling unit and will look to get the job done with the bat and level the series.

Zimbabwe didn't have the best possible start. Both the openers departed pretty quickly. Taylor in his final ODI couldn't do much though would have loved to and was the first one to depart while Regis got out to a ripper. Ervine and Madhevere did some damage control after that and stitched a partnership of 59 runs but the latter holed out. Zimbabwe soon found themselves in trouble with 99-5. The tail-enders couldn't put up a fight and the next 5 wickets fell for just 32 runs. In the end, they will be disappointed with that batting display and will have to bowl extremely well in order to get something from this match.

The Ireland spinners run a riot after the rain break and were excellent. The bowlers have done well to restrict Zimbabwe to 131 and will be eyeing a victory to level the scoreline. Zimbabwe would be very disappointed with their batting display.

OUT! BOWLED! Flatter ball, sliding in on off stump. Richard Ngarava goes on the back foot, looking to cut and the ball sneaks in quicker. Ngarava misses and the ball crashes into the off stump. ZIMBABWE HAVE BEEN BUNDLED OUT FOR 131!
Tossed up, outside off and pushed through covers. Wellington Masakadza gets the single.
On middle and driven down to long on for a single.

SAFE! A huge mix up between the batsmen and Zimbabwe escape without a scratch. Sliding down leg and tucked to short fine leg. Wellington Masakadza is already halfway down the pitch and scampers back. Simi Singh fails to collect the throw and Masakadza survives.
On off and kept out by Ngarava.
Tossed up, outside off. Wellington Masakadza drives it through cover for a single.
Bowling change.
Length again, on off. Ngarava taps it on the leg side.
Right on the money, a length ball on middle stump. Ngarava keeps it out.
Back of a length, around off. Ngarava hops to defend.
Fuller in length, on off. Wellington Masakadza pushes it to mid off for a run.
Good-length ball on middle. Wellington Masakadza plays it to cover.
Good-length ball on off, Wellington Masakadza taps it to point.
Simi Singh comes back into the attack.
On a good length, on off. Richard Ngarava blocks it out.
Short of a length, outside off. Richard Ngarava swats it back to the man at mid off.
A low full toss on leg, Richard Ngarava clears his front leg and pushes it towards covers.
Well bowled! Short ball, on middle. Richard Ngarava looks to pull but misses.
Length ball on middle, worked to square leg for a single. No ball signalled by the umpire as Josh Little overstpped. Free Hit coming up.
Good-length ball on middle, angling in. Wellington Masakadza looks to work it on the leg side. The ball goes off the inside edge onto the pads.
Length ball on off, Wellington Masakadza defends it down onto the pitch on the leg side.
Loopy ball on off. Richard Ngarava defends it out off the front foot.
Tossed up, outside off. Richard Ngarava looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Loopy ball, on off. Richard Ngarava blocks it out.
On off, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Floated it up, on middle. Richard Ngarava rocks back and looks to work it on the leg side. The ball goes off the inside edge to short fine leg for a single.
Short of a length, on off. Richard Ngarava pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Length ball outside off, Richard Ngarava swings but misses.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Wided.
Length ball, outside off. Richard Ngarava drives it to mid off.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Good-length ball, outside off. Blessing Muzarabani looks to drive but miscues. The ball goes off the inside edge and carries through to the keeper. Lorcan Tucker behind the stumps takes an easy catch. Ireland appeal for a caught behind but nothing from the umpire. Ireland opt for a review. UltraEdge shows there is a spike and the on-field decision will be overturned. Richard Ngarava is the last batsman to walk out.

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on off, Wellington Masakadza pushes it to point for a single. The fielder has a shy at the batter's end but misses. A single.
Wide! Searching for a yorker there, was Little but he misses the line and bowls it down the leg side. Wellington Masakadza looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Josh Little comes back into the attack.
On off, Blessing Muzarabani nearly chops it onto the stumps as he inside-edges it onto the pads looking to defend. A wicket maiden from Andy McBrine.
Floated it up, on off. Blessing Muzarabani punches it to cover.
Loopy ball on middle, worked on the leg side.
Flighted ball, on off. Blessing Muzarabani defends it out.
The new man in is Blessing Muzarabani.

OUT! LBW! Loopy ball, on middle and leg. Luke Jongwe looks to tuck it on the leg side but misses. He gets hit on the pads. Ireland appeal for an LBW but the umpire shakes his head. Ireland take a review. UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows all three reds. Excellent review from Ireland as it looked like it was going down the leg side to the naked eye but that isn't the case. Luke Jongwe has to walk back to the dugout now.
Floated up, on middle. Luke Jongwe looks to sweep but misses. He gets hit on the thigh pad.
Tossed up, on off. Luke Jongwe taps it towards square leg. The batters scamper across for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Full and on middle, Wellington Masakadza nudges it on the leg side for a single.
Loopy ball on middle, Wellington Masakadza blocks it out.
Full and on leg, Wellington Masakadza plays it to mid-wicket.
Who comes in?

OUT! TIMBER! Floated it up, on middle, turning in. The ball stays a little low. Ryan Burl gets down on one knee and looks to slog-sweep it over deep mid-wicket but misses. The ball goes through the gate and rattles the stumps behind him. Zimbabwe lose their seventh wicket and are in deep trouble now.
Full and on off, Burl pats it back to the bowler.
Outside off, Jongwe watchfully blocks it out.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for Zimbabwe! Short and on middle, Luke Jongwe rocks back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Streaky! Loopy ball on off, Luke Jongwe looks to defend off the front foot. The ball goes off the outside edge and races away to the third man fence.
Short and on middle. Jongwe rocks back and cuts it to cover.
On off, Jongwe presses forward and blocks it out.
Zimbabwe are living dangerously at the moment. Loopy ball, on off. Ryan Burl tucks it behind square on the leg side for a very quick single.
Tossed it up, on off. Burl clips it to square leg for one.
Short and on middle, Jongwe pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Outside off, tapped to covers.

OUT! SIKANDAR RAZA IS RUN OUT! Slight hesitation between Raza and Burl. Simi Singh bowls a loopy ball on middle, Burl nudges it towards mid-wicket for a quick single. Andy Balbirnie there quickly collects the ball and fires a throw to the keeper. Lorcan Tucker collects the ball and quickly dislodges the bails off. Ireland appeal for a run out and the umpire takes it upstairs. Replay shows Sikandar Raza is caught well short. He already started walking off as he knew it straightaway that he was a goner. Luke Jongwe walks out to bat.
The umpire have sent a run out appeal upstairs.
A googly on middle, Raza reads it well and tucks it through mid-wicket. He crosses ends.
Full and outside off, Burl pushes it towards covers for a single.
Change.
Full and outside off, Burl pushes it towards covers for a quick single. The fielder throws it back to the keeper who whips the bails off. But Sikandar Raza was well inside the crease.
Loopy ball, on off. Burls blocks it out to the off side.
We are set to resume! Ireland players make their way out. Sikandar Raza and Ryan Burl to continue their innings. Andy McBrine to complete his over.

Update 2.55 pm local (1.55 pm GMT) - We are back with good news! It has stopped drizzling and the covers are coming off. We shall resume in about 5 minutes. The match has been reduced to a 38-overs-side-a game now. Three bowlers can bowl 8 overs and two bowlers are allowed to bowl 7 overs.

Update 2.30 pm local (1.30 pm GMT) - Both the umpires have a discussion and have decided to halt the play as it has started to drizzle. The covers are coming on as well. Let's hope now that the rains don't stay for long and we resume as soon as possible.
Outside off, Sikandar Raza dabs it towards the third man region for three runs.
Full and sliding down the leg side, Burl tucks it on the leg side for one. 100 up for Zimbabwe.
On middle, blocked out.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Loopy ball around off, Ervine puts a stride forward and looks to defend. The ball kisses the outside edge and carries through to Lorcan Tucker. McBrine puts up an appeal for a caught behind but nothing from the umpire. Ireland take a review. UltraEdge shows there is a spike and Ervine will have to walk back. Huge blow to Zimbabwe. Massive breakthrough for Ireland. Ryan Burl walks out to bat now.
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Andy McBrine

Loopy ball on off, Raza blocks it out on the off side. He calls for a single but then says no.
Tossed up, around off, turning in. Raza defends it out.
Full and on leg, Ervine eases it down to long on for one.
Loopy ball on middle, Raza works it off his pads towards deep square leg for a single.
On the pads, Raza tucks it on the leg side.
Full and on middle, Raza sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single. Just two runs from it.
Floated it up, outside off. Raza lunges forward to defend but misss. He gets the shoulder off the bat towards square leg.
Short and on middle. Raza plays it on the leg side.
Full and on middle, pushed towards mid off for a single.
On middle. Ervine stays solid in his defense.

Loopy ball on off, Ervine pushes it to mid off. The fielder there does well to stop the ball diving to his left.
Loopy ball around off, Raza lets it be.
Tossed up, on middle. Raza blocks it watchfully.
Full and on off, Ervine steps out and pushes it to long on for a single.
On middle, Ervine blocks it out.
On the pads, Raza tucks it away to short fine leg for another single.

OUT! BOWLED! Brilliant bowling from Andy McBrine. Flatter and quicker, on off, a slider from McBrine. Sean Williams hangs back and looks to dab it to the off side but is beaten for pace. McBrine starts with a slider on middle and leg. Williams keeps it out on the off side.

Who will come in at number 5?

Good-length ball, outside off. Ervine looks to cut it away but misses.

Length ball, on middle and leg. Madhevere looks to tuck but misses and the ball goes off the thigh pad onto the leg side. They get a leg bye.
Good-length ball, on top of off. Madhevere taps it back onto the surface and almost chops it back onto the stumps.
Flatter one, on off stump. Ervine blocks it out.
Fuller ball, angling in on middle and leg. Ervine goes down to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals but nothing given.
FOUR! Down the leg side and Ervine looks to lift it over short fine leg. Ervine gets a top edge over the keeper's head and the ball races into the fence.
Tossed up again and driven through covers for a single. Fifty up for Zimbabwe.
Nicely flighted, on off. Madhevere gets a leading edge and the ball falls just short of a diving George Dockrell at cover.

Sliding in on middle and leg, Ervine steps out and looks to work it on the leg side. He gets an inside edge onto the pads and the ball rolls towards backward point. They scamper through for a quick single.
Length ball, outside off. Madhevere pats it back to the bowler.
Fullish ball, on off. Madhevere pushes it to mid on.
Short and wide, cut away off the back foot to deep point for a run.

Length ball, on off and moving away off the surface. Ervine looks to drive but gets beaten.
Pitched up, on middle and worked to deep mid-wicket for a single by Madhevere.
Change.

FOUR! Cheeky from Craig Ervine. Fuller one, on middle and Ervine reverse-sweeps it well past the backward point fielder for a boundary. This is turning out to be a great over for Zimbabwe.
Around off, kept out by Craig Ervine.
Flatter one, outside off. Madhevere cuts it to backward point for a quick single.

Tossed up, on middle and nudged to mid-wicket.

Good-length ball, on middle. Ervine blocks it out.
Beauty! Good-length ball on off, straightens up after pitching. Craig Ervine looks to defend but gets all squared up. The ball zips past the outside edge and carries through to the keeper.
On middle, Wesley taps it towards cover for another quick single.
Good-length ball on middle, Wesley Madhevere punches it towards covers.
On a good length, on off. Craig Ervine hops and taps it down onto the pitch. The batters take a quick single.
Length ball on middle and leg, Craig Ervine flicks it through square leg for a couple of runs.
Three runs! Width on offer outside off, Craig Ervine lunges forward and opens the face of the bat. He drives it through covers and gets three runs. Zimbabwe are 27/2 at the end of the Powerplay.
Good-length ball, on middle. Ervine knocks it towards mid on.
Length ball, on off. Craig Ervine plays it to mid on.
Full and on off, Ervine blocks it out.

Back of a length, on off. Wesley Madhevere plays it back onto the pitch. He sets off for a quick run. The keeper charges ahead and kicks the ball attempting a run out at the striker's end but misses. A single.
Length ball, on off. Wesley Madhevere gets on top of that and defends it back to the bowler.

On a good length, on off. Wesley Madhevere looks to push it on the off side but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The batters scamper through for a quick single. Josh Little collides with Craig Ervine while running ahead to collect the ball. But no harm done.
Play and a miss! Good-length ball, outside off, angling away. Wesley Madhevere looks to slap but misses.
Bit fuller from Little this time, on off. Wesley Madhevere pats it back to the bowler.
Length ball on off, Ervine works it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Cut away! Short and outside off, Craig Ervine rocks back and slashes it over covers for a boundary. No stopping that. That went like a bullet.

Peach of a delivery from Little! Good-length ball, around off, nipping away. Craig Ervine looks to defend it off the front foot but misses. The ball whizzes past the outside edge. Josh Little has been very effective since the start and is exploiting the conditions very well.
Shorter one, around off. Ervine guides it to third man for a single.
Length ball, on middle and Ervine taps it to cover-point.
Right on the money again from Adair. Ervine stays solid in defense.

Boy, oh boy. That has cut the batsman in half and Josh Little is making the ball talk. Pitched up, on off and the ball shapes back in sharply. Wesley Madhevere is bamboozled as the ball goes through the gap between bat and pad just missing top of middle stump.
Fullish ball, outside off and left alone.

OUT! BOWLED! Josh Little is putting on an amazing show of swing out there. This one is a bit fuller, around off. Regis Chakabva doesn't pick up the inswinger and makes a leave. The ball nips back and hits the top of off. Zimbabwe have lost both their openers and are on the back foot right now.
Good-length ball, on that fifth stump line. Regis Chakabva shoulders arms.
Fuller in length, outside off. Craig Ervine leaves it alone as the ball keeps a little low.
Back of a length, on leg. This one shoots up after hitting the deck. Craig Ervine gets hit on the helmet.
Back of a length, on off, coming back in. Regis Chakabva looks to defend but inside-edges it onto the pads. The ball rolls towards point for a run.
WIDE! Length ball, down the leg side. Regis Chakabva leaves it alone. Wided.
On a length on middle, Ervine pushes it to square leg for a single.
Length ball on middle, Ervine blocks it out from the crease.

Length ball on leg, Regis Chakabva looks to flick but misses. The ball goes off the thigh pad towards the right of the keeper. He fails to hold onto that one. The ball runs down to fine leg for a single.
Good-length ball, outside off, angling away. Craig Ervine shoulders arms. A wicket and four runs from it.
Good-length ball, outside off. Left alone by Ervine.
Who comes in?

OUT! TIMBER! Oh, my word! Brendan Taylor departs for 7 in his final ODI. Little bowls a good-length ball, on off, angling in. Brendan Taylor with no feet movement tries to smack it across the line. He misses the ball completely. The ball skids on and goes under his willow to rattle the off stump. Josh Little draws first blood and what a wicket for him. Brendan Taylor takes the long route back to the pavilion for the one last time.
FOUR! Thick knick on that one! Back of a length, outside off. Brendan Taylor stays deep and tries to tap it towards point. The ball goes off the outside edge and past third slip for a boundary.
Good-length ball, on middle, angling in. Taylor stays solid in defense.
Fuller in length, on off. Taylor blocks it out.
Was there an edge on it? Shorter one, on off. Regis Chakabva looks to pull but misses and the ball falls just short of the keeper.
Chakabva steps out and Adair follows him with a length ball, sliding in on leg. Chakabva misses the flick and gets hit on the body.
On the hips and Chakabva tucks it fine. Josh Little runs round from deep square leg and cuts it off, keeping it to just a couple.
Pitched up, on off and flicked straight to mid-wicket.
On a good length and outside off. Regis Chakabva doesn't play at it.
Full ball, outside off. Chakabva pats it back to the bowler.
Full and swinging in, on middle. Chakabva digs it out to mid-wicket for a single.
Pitched up, outside off and swinging in. Chakabva looks to drive but the ball beats the inside edge.
Length ball, outside off and left alone.
Taylor is off the mark in his final ODI. Another one shaping in on middle and Taylor goes for the hoick. Taylor gets it over mid-wicket and the fielder cuts it out, keeping it to three.
Length ball, on middle and leg. Taylor tucks it to square leg.
Length ball on off and shaping in beatifully. Regis Chakabva gets squared up and gets the outside edge down to third man. They take one and Zimbabwe are up and running.
Who will bowl from the other end?
On off and Taylor looks to drive. He gets it off the inner half of the bat towards mid-wicket. A maiden to start with from Mark Adair.
Length again, on off and a hint of away moevment. Taylor watchfully blocks it out.
On a driving length and outside off. Taylor keeps it out to cover.
Good-length ball, on top of off. Taylor defends it out solidly.
Short of a length, around off. Taylor dabs it down on the off side.
Adair starts with a length ball, in the channel outside off. Taylor lets it through.
Brendan Taylor receives a guard of honor from his teammates as he walks out to bat. The Ireland players also give him a guard of honor at the middle.
There is a change in the playing 11 for Ireland at the last moment. Craig Young is out and Shane Getkate comes in for him.

PITCH REPORT - Owais Shah says that the pitch is similar to the other two ODIs, with some grass on it and it is a bit damp for sure. There are some cracks and it will be interesting to see what those cracks will do. The overcast conditions will help the fast bowlers early on and there will be assistance for spinners as it has been throughout the series.

Brendan Taylor is up for a chat - Taylor says that it has been a roller-coaster ride for him. There were highs and lows but cricket has taught him a lot. Tells that anything is achievable and will not try to get past Andy Flower as he has high regard for the legend. Tells that a win will be even better. Adds that there are young players in the team and that's why he has decided to call it a day. Informs that the 2015 Cricket World Cup was probably the pinnacle of his career. Mentions that at some point he will want to come back in some form for Zimbabwe and give it back to the game. States that they need to keep improving and hopefully a series win will be great for him.

The skipper of Zimbabwe, Craig Ervine, says that it would have been an interesting chase in the previous match and says they probably would have batted first only due to the fact they have done well batting first. Informs that there is only one change.

The skipper of Ireland, Andy Balbirnie, says that they will bowl first. Mentions that they batted really well in the second ODI but were unfortunate as the rains played a spoilsport. Tells that William and Stirling were amazing at the top but were unfortunate that they didn't get to finish the game.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Brendan Taylor, Regis Chakabva (WK), Craig Ervine (C), Wesley Madhevere, Sean Williams, Sikandar Raza, Ryan Burl (In for Milton Shumba), Luke Jongwe, Wellington Masakadza, Blessing Muzarabani, Richard Ngarava.

Ireland (Playing XI) - William Porterfield, Paul Stirling, Andrew Balbirnie (C), Harry Tector, George Dockrell, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Mark Adair, Simi Singh, Andy McBrine, Shane Getkate (In place of Craig Young), Joshua Little.
TOSS - Both the captains are out in the middle. Ireland have won the toss and have elected to BOWL first.

There will be an inspection now at 12.00 pm local (11.00 am GMT).

Update 11.10 am local (10.10 am GMT) - There is still some rain hovering around and the covers are intact. We have news from the center and there will be an inspection at 11.30 am local (10.30 am GMT). We will be back with more updates. Stay tuned.

Update 10.15 am local (9.15 am GMT) - The live pictures from the ground do not look good. It is raining at the moment. There will be an inspection at 11 am local (10 am GMT) but for that, first, the rain has to stop. Till then, stay tuned.

Update 10.00 am local (9 am GMT) - The news from the middle is that it is raining in Belfast at the moment and the toss has been officially delayed. Let's stay positive and hope that we are not in for a long delay. Stay tuned for further updates.

Brendan Taylor will be calling it a day and is set to represent in the Zimbabwe colors for the last time. He has left his biggest imprint in this format and is one of Zimbabwe's greats. With the series on the line, he would want to deliver one for the final time, as so he has done countless times in red for the past 17 years.

Ireland will be locking horns against Zimbabwe in the third and final ODI of the series. Zimbabwe won the first ODI and with the second ODI getting washed out, they have an unassailable lead of 1-0. A win here for the visitors will seal the deal for them. On the other hand, the Irish side put up a great show in the second ODI but the rains played a spoilsport and the match got abandoned. It all boils down to the final clash now. Ireland will look to get a win and level the scoreline while Zimbabwe would aim for a series victory. But for that to happen, let's hope another rain-marred match is not on the cards as the forecast isn't a promising one. On that note, welcome to the coverage.
